other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Fitting feature transformers (like TF-IDF, SVD) or computing aggregate statistics on the entire training dataset before splitting it into cross-validation folds leaks validation information into the training representations, resulting in overly optimistic OOF scores.

other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect submission ID column
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the submission file using an arbitrary sequence of integers instead of the actual identifier column from the test dataset. This will cause the submission to fail evaluation if a specific ID column (e.g., PetID) is expected.

other_failure_modes.name: Overfitting thresholds on OOF predictions
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits the rounding thresholds on the out-of-fold predictions and then evaluates the validation metric on those exact same OOF predictions, yielding a biased and overly optimistic validation score.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated and effective solution using regression with optimized rounding thresholds, which is the optimal approach for ordinal classification evaluated on QWK. However, it introduces data leakage during cross-validation by fitting TF-IDF, SVD, and group statistics on the entire training set before splitting, and by fitting the rounder on the OOF predictions it evaluates. Critically, it constructs the submission file with an auto-generated integer ID column instead of extracting the test set's identifier, which will cause evaluation to fail.
